Name: Sylnan's Fedora Hat Retexture (Just Roll With It)
Author: salutatien
Description:
A basic retexture of the player's fedora hat, made to look like Sylnan's from his season 1 design!! This mod simply replaces the sprite, so as usual you can find the fedora on the 16th of Fall, sold at the Stardew Valley Fair.

Requires the content patcher and SMAPI.

Should be compatible with other hat replacer mods, as long as they don't affect the fedora. But let me know if there are any problems and I'll see what I can do!!
